explanation: One line of argument holds that joining the Community, and later the euro, took away the option of devaluing and made credit cheap. On that reading the debt built up and Portuguese goods lost ground abroad, and that ended in the 2011 request for assistance.

dispute.text: The counter-argument puts the crisis in choices made at home: the flow of credit to parts of the economy that do not export, fiscal policy, and the failure to raise productivity. Membership permitted those choices and did not dictate them. On that reading the 1986 accession is context rather than cause.
